annotations.title: Binding tariff information for a code

description: Lists binding tariff information (BTI) decisions issued by EU customs authorities and published by the European Commission (EBTI) for a code: the exact 10-digit code, its 8-digit CN subheading, its 6-digit HS subheading or its 4-digit heading. Each decision carries its reference, issuing country, validity, the description of the goods and the justification, in the language in which it was issued. Decisions in force come first. Covers the EU customs tariff (TARIC) as applied in Spain (mainland and Balearic Islands). Not valid for the Canary Islands, Ceuta or Melilla. For guidance only, not binding.

code.description: 4, 6, 8 or 10 digits (dots and spaces are accepted).

language.description: Language of the texts returned: Spanish (es), Catalan (ca) or English (en). Official EU texts not published in Catalan are returned in Spanish.

level.description: Level to list: the exact 10-digit code, its 8-digit CN subheading, its 6-digit HS subheading or its 4-digit heading. Defaults to the number of digits given.

page.description: Page of results, 5 decisions per page.
